notes.title: Update August 17th - v0.9.0
notes.notes: [p]Hello, dreamers![/p][p]Today’s major update brings some essential new features to enhance the gameplay experience![/p][p]As always, feel free to join our Discord for exclusive giveaways, updates or to discuss among yourselves and with the developer! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH"]https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review to help with visibility! Dream on![/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h1][b]Combat[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Hovering over the state icons of characters and enemies now displays the respective state’s description[/p][/*][*][p]Critical hits now play an additional animation[/p][/*][*][p]Text indicating an effective hit now will be red if the attack is a critical hit[/p][/*][*][p]Rephrased the text when failing to hit the enemy from “MISS” to “EVADE”[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies in the Digital Training Grounds now appear as holograms[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Characters[/b][/h1][p][b]Player[/b][/p][p]Marks are difficult to utilize efficiently in difficult combat situations. To allow for more situations in which they can be, Empiric Prediction will trigger them much more frequently now.[/p][list][*][p]Increased effect of Empiric Prediction[/p][list][*][p]Old:  20/25/30/35/40% chance to apply a Mark on a random target at turn start[/p][/*][*][p]New: 20/40/60/80/100% chance to apply a Mark on a random target at turn start[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1][b]Items[/b][/h1][p]The hunt for rare equipment is an integral part of the gameplay loop of Eternal Dreamers Rising. I’ve had players boast about their inventory filled with rare items, the elusive TRUE prefix and armor with nothing but gold sockets (statistically nearly impossible!) I wanted to make obtaining and managing these items an even more fulfilling experience. To that end, this update introduces several new features relating to item management![/p][list][*][p]Weapons, armor and sprits now can be locked/unlocked by pressing “Shift” from the item or equip screen[/p][list][*][p]Added a visual indicator for locked items[/p][/*][*][p]Locked items do not appear in the sellable items list[/p][/*][*][p]Rare weapons, armor and spirits are locked by default[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following items now can be sold[/p][list][*][p]Half Reviver: 1,000 energy[/p][/*][*][p]Dream Amplifiers: 1,000 energy[/p][/*][*][p]Reset Amplifier: 500 energy[/p][/*][*][p]12-star rarity: 25,000 energy[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rare armor now can be sold:[/p][list][*][p]10-star rarity: 15,000 energy[/p][/*][*][p]11-star rarity: 20,000 energy[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Armor socket slots now are sorted by tier (1. gold, 2. silver, 3. bronze)[/p][list][*][p]Added a visual indicator showing a socket slot’s actual tier even when a lower tier socket has been equipped[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1][b]General[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Added a new rare drop animation[/p][/*][*][p]Reworded selected state descriptions and system text[/p][/*][*][p]Further improved game performance[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Guide[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Updated guide[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Crimson Edge no longer applies Soul Veil when used by enemies[/p][/*][*][p]All rare socket pieces now sell for the correct price[/p][/*][*][p]Socket pieces now are sorted correctly in the socket piece equip window[/p][/*][*][p]The readiness meter now displays even with the enemy status window open[/p][/*][*][p]Potentially fixed issue causing the boss HP bar to appear unnaturally long[/p][/*][*][p]Weather will now appear as intended in the quest area Sanctum[/p][/*][*][p]Death’s Fruit now can be selected as single targets using mouse movement in the battle with M1-Nolith[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update April 16th - v0.8.0
notes.notes:
Hello, dreamers!

Today’s major update adds a ton of new stuff!
Corrin, a warrior shrouded in mystery, makes her appearance as a new boss and playable character?! 
Next, the mining mode has been enriched with special events to spice up each mining session!
And finally, several performance improvements have been made to make the game run even smoother!

As always, feel free to join our Discord for exclusive giveaways, updates or to discuss among yourselves and with the developer! https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH


If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review to help with visibility! Dream on!

[h1]Quests[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new one-time high difficulty quest required to unlock Corrin as a playable character
     -Unlock condition: Clear main quest area Depths
[/list]
[h1]Mining[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a Dragon mini-boss to all mining depths
     -Awakes after 40s
     -Fought with mining inputs like regular nodes
     -Defeating it grants access to an area with 4 mining nodes
[*]Added a treasure room to all mining depths
     -Opened by stepping on 3 buttons located somewhere within the mining depth
     -Treasure consists of +5 weapon/armor/item/ability/gift stones
[*]Increased mining time in all mining depths
     -Old: 45s
     -New: 1m
[*]The teleport function is available in the mining area outside of active mining sessions
[*]Increased number of mineral nodes
[*]Rebalanced roadblock and enemy placement
[*]Improved lighting in all mining depths
[/list]
[h1]Characters[/h1]

[b]NEW CHARACTER: Corrin[/b]
Corrin is an offensive-oriented TECH type character with various time-themed abilities. Expect devestating double turns, ability recasts and turn order manipulation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544716/f4b8329b4b5dd2b6abdc54c926638ed9d6bd13ec.png[/img]

[h3]Abilities[/h3]

LEVEL 1

Temporal Shift
[list]
[*](4AP) (1 enemy) (charge gain)
[*]Deal heavy DMG to one enemy. Gain another turn at a chance of 25%
[/list]
Recursive Echo
[list]
[*](3AP) (all enemies) (charge gain)
[*]Deal moderate DMG to all enemies. If a target dies, deal DMG to every remaining target one more time
[/list]
LEVEL 2

Tachyon Surge
[list]
[*](3AP) (all allies) (charge loss) (instant)
[*]Increase readiness of all allies but Corrin by 16/17/18/19/20%. Gain Tachyon Charge
[/list]
Graviton Snare
[list]
[*](3AP) (all enemies) (charge loss) (instant)
[*]Decrease readiness of all enemies by 16/17/18/19/20%. Gain Graviton Charge
[/list]
GAUGE

Zero Hour
[list]
[*](all enemies) (3 gauge)
[*]Reduce readiness of all enemies by 100%, before consuming Tachyon and Graviton Charge. Requires Tachyon and Graviton Charge
[/list]
PASSIVE

Singularity Record
[list]
[*]Nullify DMG taken every 7/6/5/4/3 times suffering an attack
[*]A way to upgrade the passive from level 1 will be added in a future update
[/list]
[h1]Enemies[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added new boss-type enemy: Space-time Anomaly
[*]Added new enemies: Tachyon, Graviton
[/list]
[h1]Status Effects[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added two new status effects:
     -Tachyon Charge (max 1): Accumulated power pulling towards the future.
     -Graviton Charge (max 1): Accumulated power pulling towards the past.
[*]To decrease visual clutter, status effect removal and expiration no longer shows a popup
[/list]
[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased the effect of ATK/Boost:
     -Old: +2/4/7 ATK
     -New: +3/6/9 ATK
[*]Changed the effect of AP/Regen:
     -Old: +4/5/6% AP per turn
     -New: +1/2/3 AP per turn. Socket effect does not stack
[*]Changed the effect of AP/Demise:
     -Old: +1/2/3 AP & +4/5/6% AP per turn
     -New: +1/2/3 AP & +1/2/3 AP per turn. Socket regen effect does not stack
[*]Reset Amplifiers can also be used on fully upgraded equipment
[/list]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Using amplifiers will show changes to weapon stats immediately upon use
[*]Updated version and select system text
[*]Severely reduced load, save and transition times
[*]Improved DMG popups
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Soul Veil will always apply 4 stacks as intended
[*]Marlon’s and enemy strike and abilities will no longer crit while under the effect of Counter
[*]ShirA.I. will receive sympathy points from battles as intended
[*]Using Reset Amplifier no longer removes the “TRUE” prefix effects on rare weapons
[*]Party Meter will always begin at 0 segments when challenging the Digital Training Grounds
[*]Potentially fixed issue of boss hp par ocassionally appearing unnaturally large until the boss enemy suffers DMG
[*]Fixed incorrect shadows in mining depth 4
[/list]

notes.title: Update February 19th - v0.7.0
notes.notes:
Hello, dreamers!

Today’s update notably reworks Faeris and Shana and brings additional rebalancing to respond to player feedback! Thank you!

As always, feel free to join our Discord for exclusive giveaways, updates or to discuss among yourselves and with the developer! https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH


If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review to help with visibility! Dream on!

[h1]Characters[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworded several ability descriptions for clarity and consistency
[/list]
[h3]Marlon[/h3]
Marlon commonly is benched once other DMG-focused characters are unlocked. These buffs will help him perform better in the lategame.

[list]
[*]Changed the effect of Justice Strike
     -Old: Deal heavy DMG to one enemy
     -New: Deal heavy DMG to one enemy. DMG dealt scales with the target’s max HP
[*]Changed the effect of the Counter status effect:
     -Old: The next attack on this actor is evaded and countered
     -New: The next attack on this actor is evaded and countered with a critical hit
[*]Increased DMG of Shield Bash
[/list]
[h3]Reiketsu[/h3]
Shadow Strike is a strong ability particularly into the lategame. To curb Reiketsu’s dominance among DMG dealers, Shadow Strike now will perform worse against bosses and she will have a slightly harder time evading attacks.

[list]
[*]Shadow Strike will deal less DMG against targets with high max HP
[*]Decreased the effect of Shadow Cloak:
     -Old: +35% evasion & +10% AP regen
     -New: +30% evasion & +10% AP regen
[/list]
[h3]Monolith[/h3]
Monolith struggles to survive against lategame enemies. To increase his survivability, Soul Drain now will recover more HP.

[list]
[*]Increased the effect of Soul Drain
     -Old: Steal 15% of Monolith’s HP per turn
     -New: Steal 20% of Monolith’s HP per turn
[/list]
[h3]Faeris[/h3]
Faeris has struggled to see play due to the other powerful supporters available. Additionally, she’s also felt stiff to play compared to other characters. The aim of this comprehensive rework is to give her a more unique niche and allow her to be a more proactive participant in battle while staying true to her vow to keep the party safe.

[list]
[*]Renamed Sacred Arrows into Sacred Rain
[*]Replaced the level 1 ability Cure with Blessed Current
     -Blessed Current: (3AP) (Charge Gain) Cure one ally of all applied afflictions. Increase the target's readiness by 20% times the number of active Soul Veil
[*]Replaced the level 2 ability Holy Prism with Divine Prism
     -Divine Prism: (3AP) (Charge Loss) Deal heavy DMG to one enemy. DMG dealt increases for every stack of Soul Veil
[*]Replaced the level 2 ability Heal with White Wave
     -White Wave: (3AP) (Charge Loss) Deal moderate DMG to all enemies. If active, gain 1 stack of Soul Veil for every target hit
[*]Replaced the meter ability Holy Veil with Soul Renewal
     -Soul Renewal: (4 meter) (Instant) Gain 4 stacks of Soul Veil. Cannot use if Soul Veil is active
     -Soul Veil: Allies recover 30% of their HP at the beginning of their turn, consuming a charge of Soul Veil [max 10]
[*]Replaced the passive ability Nature’s Blessing with Spirit Calling
     -Spirit Calling: Decrease the effective cooldown of spirits by 4/5/6/7/8 turns
[/list]
[h3]Shana[/h3]
Shana’s abilities reward her for dispatching regular enemies, which has her performance lack in fights against bosses. The aim of this rework is to make her a powerful ally in fights against even these powerful opponents.

[list]
[*]Changed the effect of Grief Shot
     -Old: Deal moderate DMG to one enemy before increasing Shana’s DMG by 25% for 1 turn at a chance of 75% 
     -New: Deal moderate DMG to one enemy before increasing Shana’s DMG by 25% for 1 turn
[*]Changed the effect of Anguish Shot
     -Old: (5AP) Deal heavy DMG to one enemy. If the target dies, gain 4AP
     -New: (4AP) Deal heavy DMG to one enemy. DMG dealt scales with the target’s max HP
[*]Changed the effect of Penitence Ray
     -Old: Deal moderate DMG to one enemy. If the target dies, gain another turn
     -New: Deal moderate DMG to one enemy. If the target dies, gain 2 party meter segments and another turn
[*]Reduced cost of Remorse Shot from 5AP to 4AP
[/list]
[h1]Enemies[/h1]
[list]
[*]Applied all ability changes made to actors to equivalent enemy abilities
[*]Weary Reaper, Death will additionally gain Poisoned Resist as the fight progresses
[*]Anna (Digital Training Grounds) will additionally use the ability Pulsating Call
[/list]
[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed the effect of the Fire Spirit’s ability:
     -Old: Apply Encouraged (+25% DMG) for 2 turns
     -New: Apply Enraged (+25% DMG) for 2 turns
[/list]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]HP Regen effects will heal 1 HP if the target suffers from Unhealable
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]HP Regen effects will no longer ignore Unhealable
[*]Raze’s ability Basilisk Touch will no longer increase her charge level and take abnormally long to execute
[*]Fixed issue that caused abnormal beavior with the charge level of Weary Reaper, Death
[*]Fixed issue that caused abnormal screen behavior when equipping items with a HP loss effect
[*]The weapon Twilight Blade will properly apply its additional DMG effect
[*]Potentially fixed issue that caused random crashes when booting up the game due to images failing to load
[*]Fixed identified typos
[/list]

notes.notes:
Hello, dreamers!

Today’s update implements various feedback and bug fixes requested by you lot! Thank you!

As always, feel free to join our Discord for exclusive giveaways, updates or to discuss among yourselves and with the developer! https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH

[h1]Characters[/h1]
[h3]Reiketsu[/h3]
Reiketsu’s meter ability seldomly sees plays against the game’s bosses due to their innate ability to enrage and gain charge level 2 when reduced to charge level 0. To make it a viable option, the ability will no longer decrease the target’s charge level to 0, and rather decrease it by 1. To compensate the utility loss against regular enemies, the ability’s DMG has been slightly increased.
[list]
[*]Altered effects of meter ability: Assassinate
     -Old: Deal heavy DMG to one enemy and reduce the target's charge level to 0
     -New: Deal heavy DMG to one enemy and reduce the target's charge level by 1
[*]Slightly increased DMG of Assassinate
[/list]

Hello, dreamers!

Today’s update is focused on reworking Anna’s kit to work more comfortably! 

As always, feel free to join our Discord for exclusive giveaways, updates or to discuss among yourselves and with the developer! https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH


If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review to help with visibility! Dream on!

[h1]Characters[/h1]
[h3]Anna[/h3]
Anna’s playstyle has her sacrifice and recover HP in turn to deal both heavy DMG to enemy and heal her allies. To relieve the stress of managing her HP, her passive ability has changed to allow for reliable HP recovery after every attack. This alievates the need to use Blood Echo or Bloodlust, both restricted by the party meter or ability level respectively, and means Blood Explosion now has decreased detrimental effects. Since Bloodlust has lost its purpose, the status effect is being removed. Instead, Crimson Edge now is an ability that deals increased DMG the lower Anna’s HP at the time the ability is used, rewarding those who manage her HP well.
[list]
[*]Replaced passibe ability: Raging Berserker -> Vampiric Blade
     -Vampiric Blade: Recovers 5/7.5/10/12.5/15% of DMG dealt in HP
[*]Altered effects of active ability: Crimson Edge
     -Old: Anna gains Bloodlust, before dealing heavy DMG to one enemy
     -New: Deals heavy DMG to one enemy. Increases DMG dealt by up to 40/55/70/85/100% based on the user's missing HP
[/list]
[h1]Enemies[/h1]
[list]
[*]Altered effects of active ability: Crimson Edge
     -Old: User gains Bloodlust, before dealing heavy DMG to one enemy
     -New: Deals heavy DMG to one enemy. Increases DMG dealt by up to 40/55/70/85/100% based on the user's missing HP
[/list]
[h1]Status Effects[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed Bloodlust
[/list]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added dialogue when purchasing a Fashion item
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Blood Explosion will no longer be shown as one of Anna’s selectable abilities on old savestates
[*]Fixed issue that kept Anna’s and Sakia’s fashion item appearance unchanged if the resptive DLC was removed
[/list]

notes.title: Update November 27th - v0.6.0
notes.notes:
Hello, dreamers!

Today’s update expands the line-up of casino games with the much-requested Blackjack! 
Personally, I think that dealer got nothing on me! (I lost everything)

As it has been frequently requested, navigating the quest selection screen now is possible using keyboard and controller! Please let me know if you find any weird interactions with the new map!
On the fashion side of things, the tantalizing Bunny Anna and Maid Sakia make their debut, coming in with a 15% launch discount!

As always, feel free to join our Discord for exclusive giveaways, updates or to discuss among yourselves and with the developer! [url=https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH]https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH[/url]

If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review to help with visibility! Dream on!

notes.title: Update 18.08.24 - v0.5.5
notes.notes:
Hello, dreamers!

Today’s update notably introduces Fashion items to the game! These new outfits change the appearance of characters in combat! Let’s close out Summer with some breezy fits!

In terms of QoL, this update makes several changes to reduce the time investment to complete runs in the main quest, upgrade shops and when hunting for rare equipment! 

As always, feel free to join our Discord for exclusive giveaways, updates or to discuss among yourselves and with the developer!
[url=https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH]https://discord.gg/DQuU4haBDH[/url]

[b]New Fashion: Summer ShirA.I.[/b] -15% launch discount (Releases approx. August 20th)
